claim.quote: The high precision information on higher order flow coefficients is a major step forward in constraining the equation-of-state of dense baryonic matter.

name: HADES flow harmonics of protons, deuterons and tritons in Au+Au at 2.4 GeV

summary.plain: HADES measured how protons, deuterons and tritons stream out of gold-gold collisions at 2.4 GeV, with flow coefficients up to the sixth order, giving a detailed picture of the pressure of the fireball and constraining the equation of state of dense baryonic matter.
summary.technical: Flow coefficients v_n (n = 1-6) for p, d and t versus centrality, transverse momentum and rapidity in Au+Au at sqrt(sNN) = 2.4 GeV, constructing a multi-differential angular emission pattern for the first time at a few GeV; a step forward in constraining the equation of state of dense baryonic matter.

title: Directed, elliptic and higher order flow harmonics of protons, deuterons and tritons in Au+Au collisions at sqrt(sNN) = 2.4 GeV
why_it_matters: High-precision higher-order flow data at the energy of neutron-star mergers constrain the stiffness of nuclear matter.
